privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We take the protection of your personal data very seriously. This privacy policy informs you about the nature, scope and purpose of processing personal data when using MSK Shortener.
privacy.section1Text: The controller responsible for data processing on this website is:
privacy.section2Intro: MSK Shortener is designed to be deliberately data-minimal. We only process the following data:
privacy.section2aTitle: a) Submitted URLs and short codes
privacy.section2aText: When you shorten a link, we store the submitted target URL, the generated or self-chosen short code, an optional password (as a bcrypt hash) and an optional expiry date. This data is necessary to provide the URL shortener service.
privacy.section2bText: When creating a link and on every click on a short link, your IP address is stored exclusively as a salted SHA-256 hash. The original IP address is never stored in plain text. This is used for abuse prevention (rate limiting) and the anonymous creation of click statistics.
privacy.section2cText: On every click on a short link, the browser type (e.g. Chrome), operating system (e.g. Windows) and device type (desktop/mobile/tablet) are stored. This information is derived from the User-Agent header and contains no personal data.
privacy.section2dText: If your browser transmits referrer information (the page from which you accessed the short link), we store only the domain and path – not the query parameters, as they could contain sensitive information.
privacy.section3Text: MSK Shortener uses exclusively a single technically necessary cookie to store your language selection:
privacy.section3CookiePurpose: Purpose: Storing the selected language (German or English)
privacy.section3NoTracking: No tracking cookies, analytics cookies or advertising cookies are used.
privacy.section4Text: Processing of your data is based on Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR (contract performance) and Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR (legitimate interests – abuse prevention and provision of anonymous statistics).
privacy.section5Links: Short links are stored until they are either deleted by the creator using the delete token or until the optional expiry date is reached.
privacy.section5Clicks: Anonymized click data is stored indefinitely, as it has no personal reference.
privacy.section5Logs: Server logs (Apache access logs) are automatically deleted after a maximum of 14 days.
privacy.section6Intro: Your data is not shared with third parties, with the following exception:
privacy.section6HostingText: This website is operated on servers of Netcup GmbH (Daimlerstraße 25, 76185 Karlsruhe, Germany). A data processing agreement pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR exists with Netcup.
privacy.section7Intro: You have the following rights at any time:
privacy.section7RightAccess: Access to the data stored about you (Art. 15 GDPR)
privacy.section7RightComplaint: Complaint to a supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR)
privacy.section7Contact: To exercise your rights, please contact us using the contact details above.
privacy.section8AuthorityName: The State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information Baden-Württemberg
privacy.section9Text: We use technical and organizational security measures to protect your data against manipulation, loss or unauthorized access. Transmission is encrypted via HTTPS (TLS). Passwords are hashed with bcrypt (cost factor 12). IP addresses are hashed with SHA-256 using a secret salt.
privacy.section10Text: We reserve the right to adapt this privacy policy to changes in legal requirements or service updates. The new privacy policy will apply on your next visit.
